text:
I dreamed the one who held my love subject to herself threw me from a cliff, and a beast waiting below almost caught me in its mouth.

Fearfully I sought something my hands could hold: one grasped a sword's edge and the other dug into a little plant.

The plant was swiftly uprooted, the sword was destroying my hand, and I pressed its living edges harder...

O wretched me, how poorly I understand myself, for I delight to see myself torn apart from fear of ending my pain by dying!

translation.title: I Dreamed I Was Thrown from a Cliff
